name: skins
description: Skins for Claude Code: tool rows that open onto their input and answer, highlighted code, diff, table, math, Mermaid and shell cards, links, folding, a usage band, a calm mode and fifteen themes. /skin swaps them live.

managedCompatibility.title: Managed security compatibility
managedCompatibility.description: Skip hooks blocked by the built-in managed security guard. Skins still draws charts, but does not add chart hints to the system prompt; session preferences reload on the next UI invalidation.
